summary: ABC Supply Phase 3 (Ordering & Order Tracking) end-to-end tested. Authored /app/backend/tests/test_abc_supply_p3_api.py (14 HTTP-integration cases) — ALL 14 PASS against the deployed preview URL against the local ABC mock, covering: pre-submit review OK, review-flags-unavailable, submit happy path (confirmed + MOCK-CONF-*), MANDATORY price refresh (price_changed then accepted), duplicate protection (same key + new key both -> already_submitted with the same confirmation), 4-way concurrent submit (exactly ONE confirmed), MOCK-REJECT -> failed, MOCK-TIMEOUT -> unknown -> unknown-on-retry (no auto-retry) -> reconcile -> reconciled, abc-refresh-status returns abc_status/normalized_status/order_number, orders/history + orders/{confirmation} + templates return Standard Reroof Kit, RBAC 403 for sales on all P3 endpoints, and regression (generic non-ABC PO create+status+receive still works; a submitted ABC PO is NOT auto-received). Frontend: verified via Playwright — 'ABC Supply Orders' tab (data-testid tab-abc-orders) lists submitted orders in abc-orders-table with Processing status. HOWEVER a CRITICAL frontend-backend integration bug was found: POOut does NOT expose external_confirmation_number / external_order_number / abc_order_status / abc_normalized_status / abc_submitted_at / abc_last_sync_at, so on the Purchase Orders tab every ABC PO (even already-confirmed 'ordered' ones like PO-0081..PO-0092) shows the button as 'Submit to ABC' instead of flipping to 'ABC Order', and the AbcOrderPanel status view (submitted = !!po.external_confirmation_number) never renders. Backend duplicate protection guards against a re-order, but the UX is broken.

critical.issue: POOut schema (backend/schemas_phase4.py:191 & _out() in backend/routers/purchasing.py:30) omits the ABC order-tracking fields the frontend depends on: external_confirmation_number, external_order_number, abc_order_status, abc_normalized_status, abc_submitted_at, abc_last_sync_at. Reproduced: after /abc-submit returns {status:'confirmed', confirmation_number:'MOCK-CONF-10009'} and PO.status becomes 'ordered', GET /api/purchase-orders/{id} returns all six of these ABC fields as null/absent. This breaks the Inventory > Purchase Orders view — the 'Submit to ABC' button (Inventory.jsx:124) never switches to 'ABC Order', and AbcOrderPanel status view (AbcOrderPanel.jsx:20) never activates.

ui_bugs.issue: Rows for ABC POs already in status 'ordered' (with a stored MOCK-CONF confirmation) still show the primary action as 'Submit to ABC' rather than 'ABC Order'. Caused by the missing POOut fields above.
abc-order-status view never renders for confirmed POs (submitted = !!po.external_confirmation_number is always false). Refresh button (abc-refresh-status) is not reachable via the panel.

integration_issues.flow: ABC submit -> PO row state update
integration_issues.issue: After a successful POST /api/purchase-orders/{id}/abc-submit, the PO list refresh does not propagate the confirmation to the UI because the fields are stripped by POOut. Row still looks unsubmitted.

action_items: Add external_confirmation_number, external_order_number, abc_order_status, abc_normalized_status, abc_submitted_at, abc_last_sync_at to POOut in /app/backend/schemas_phase4.py and populate them in _out() in /app/backend/routers/purchasing.py. This is required for the P3 UX (Submit-to-ABC -> ABC Order label swap, AbcOrderPanel status view, Refresh button) to function.
Consider whether the 'Receive' button should be hidden or disabled on ABC POs in status 'ordered' until ABC delivery is confirmed, to avoid receiving before delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: POOut is out of sync with the PurchaseOrder model for the six new ABC-order fields (models.py migration c3f6a8b1d2e5) — schema drift; unit test on _out() would catch this.

abc_submit sets po.status='ordered' but relies on the frontend polling abc-refresh-status to fetch abc_order_status. Because status/normalized_status are already stored on the PO row after submit, exposing them via POOut would remove an unnecessary extra roundtrip.

abc-submit's price_changed branch: when a stored line has cost N and mock returns M, the response prev/updated totals treat unavailable lines as unit_cost*qty which can be misleading for lines that were 0. Minor UX nit — otherwise correct.

abc-reconcile matches by po.number against history's 'purchaseOrder' field (a truncated 20-char string sent via /orders). If PO numbers ever exceed 20 chars this will silently fail to match; the truncation happens in abc-submit (po.number[:20]). Consider echoing the truncated value or matching by requestId as a fallback.
The mock's in-memory _MOCK_ORDERS store resets on backend reload (documented). This is fine for tests but note it in the runbook so ops don't rely on it in preview.

success_rate.frontend: PARTIAL — ABC Supply Orders tab (tab-abc-orders) works and lists 9 submitted orders with Processing status; Purchase Orders 'Submit to ABC' button label/state does NOT reflect submitted status (see critical bug).

rca of the issue: POOut Pydantic schema (schemas_phase4.py:191) and its populator _out() (routers/purchasing.py:30) were not updated when migration c3f6a8b1d2e5 added the ABC order tracking columns to the PurchaseOrder model. As a result the DB is updated correctly on /abc-submit (verified: po.status='ordered', po.external_confirmation_number stored) but the API layer strips those fields from GET responses. Fix: extend POOut with the six Optional fields and pass po.external_confirmation_number, po.external_order_number, po.abc_order_status, po.abc_normalized_status, po.abc_submitted_at, po.abc_last_sync_at in _out().
